title: State of Tamil Nadu through Superintendent of Police, CBI/SIT v. Nalini

content.caseIdentity: State of Tamil Nadu through Superintendent of Police, CBI/SIT v. Nalini, (1999) 5 SCC 253
content.holding: The Rajiv Gandhi assassination appeals where the Supreme Court settled the doctrine of criminal conspiracy: the unlawful agreement is the very nucleus of the offence; once the agreement to commit a crime is proved, no overt act is necessary. A conspirator is liable for all acts done in furtherance of the common design.
